chunks: Safwan ibn Yahya wrote to Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام:

He asked him about a man who has two garments, one of which was affected by urine, but he does not know which of the two it is. When the time of salat arrives, he fears missing it, and he has no water with him, what should he do? He said:
He should perform salat in both of them.

key_terms.بَوْلٌ: urine; a source of ritual impurity

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if one of two garments is contaminated with urine and he does not know which one it is before salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a case of uncertainty regarding najasah on one of two garments. If a person does not know which garment is impure, fears the salat time will pass, and has no water available, he should pray in both garments.
